hook.convey: a straight line = a straight angle = half a turn = 180°; a second line or ray leaving one point on it splits that 180° into two neighbouring angles → together they always fill the straight line; a road meeting a train track, a slanted line on a drawn straight line

use.hi: Railway crossing par train ki seedhi patri ke ek bindu se ek sadak tirchhi nikalti hai. Patri ke ek taraf sadak do angle banati hai, ek chhota aur ek bada, aur dono milkar poori seedhi patri bhar dete hain.
use.en: At a railway crossing, a road leaves one point of the straight train track at a slant. On one side of the track the road makes two angles, one small and one big, and together they fill the whole straight track.

use.hi: Drawing copy mein ek seedhi line kheencho, phir uske kisi bindu se ek tirchhi line upar ki taraf kheencho. Ab seedhi line ke upar do angle bane hain, aur tirchhi line jitni jhukegi, ek angle utna bada aur doosra utna chhota hoga.
use.en: In your drawing copy, draw a straight line, then from some point on it draw a slanted line going up. Now there are two angles above the straight line, and the more the slanted line leans, the bigger one angle gets and the smaller the other.

explain.convey: straight line = straight angle = 180°; a ray from a point on it → two neighbouring angles with a common arm, together = the straight angle → a linear pair (rekhik yugm), sum 180°; board: the straight line and a 50° angle → the child finds the partner 180° − 50° = 130°

point.hi: Yeh seedhi line hai, aur seedhi line 180° ka angle hoti hai, aadha chakkar. Iske ek bindu se ek ray nikli aur ek taraf 50° ka angle bana. Dono bagal wale angle hain aur milkar poori seedhi line bharte hain. Aise jode ko linear pair kehte hain, aur uska jod hamesha 180° hota hai.
point.en: This is a straight line, and a straight line is an angle of 180°, half a turn. A ray left one point on it and made a 50° angle on one side. The two are neighbouring angles and together they fill the whole straight line. Such a pair is called a linear pair, and its sum is always 180°.

prompt.hi: Toh is seedhi line par 50° ke bagal wala doosra angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: So on this straight line, what is the other angle next to the 50°?

why.hi: seedhi line 180° hai, aur 180° − 50° = 130°
why.en: a straight line is 180°, and 180° − 50° = 130°

simpler.hi: Seedhi line poora 180° hoti hai. Ray use do bagal wale angles mein baant deti hai, aur dono milkar 180° hi banate hain.
simpler.en: A straight line is a full 180°. The ray splits it into two neighbouring angles, and together they still make 180°.

explain.convey: the two angles of a linear pair need not be equal: 70° and 110° → different, sum 180°; when one grows the other shrinks (the sum stays 180°) → the child moves the 70° to 100° and finds the new partner 80°, not 100°

point.hi: Yeh ek linear pair ke do angle hain, 70° aur 110°. Dono barabar nahi hain, phir bhi milkar 180° hote hain. Ray ko ghumao toh ek angle bada hota hai aur doosra chhota, par jod 180° hi rehta hai.
point.en: These are the two angles of a linear pair, 70° and 110°. They are not equal, yet together they make 180°. Turn the ray and one angle gets bigger while the other gets smaller, but the sum stays 180°.

prompt.hi: Agar is jode ka 70° wala angle badhkar 100° ho jaaye, toh uska bagal wala angle kitna ho jaayega?
prompt.en: If the 70° angle of this pair grows to 100°, what does the angle next to it become?

why.hi: 70° aur 110° ka jod 180° tha; 70° badhkar 100° hua, toh bagal wala 180° − 100° = 80°
why.en: 70° and 110° made 180°; 70° grew to 100°, so the neighbour is 180° − 100° = 80°

simpler.hi: Linear pair mein ek angle bada ho toh doosra utna hi chhota ho jaata hai. Jaise 70° aur 110°, jod hamesha 180° rehta hai.
simpler.en: In a linear pair, when one angle grows the other shrinks by the same amount. Like 70° and 110°, the sum always stays 180°.

problem.hi: Railway crossing par ek seedhi sadak train ki seedhi patri se milti hai, aur seedhi patri 180° ki hai. Patri ke ek taraf sadak do angle banati hai jo linear pair hain, aur ek angle doosre se 30° bada hai. Dono angle nikaalo.
problem.en: At a railway crossing a straight road meets the straight train track, and a straight track is 180°. On one side of the track the road makes two angles that form a linear pair, and one angle is 30° bigger than the other. Find both angles.

simpler.hi: Patri ke ek taraf sadak do angle banati hai jo linear pair hain, aur seedhi patri 180° ki hai. Ek angle doosre se 30° bada hai. Dono angle chahiye.
simpler.en: On one side of the track the road makes two angles that form a linear pair, and the straight track is 180°. One angle is 30° bigger than the other. We need both angles.

givens.hi: dono angle linear pair hain, toh unka jod 180° hai
givens.en: the two angles form a linear pair, so their sum is 180°

givens.hi: ek angle doosre se 30° bada hai
givens.en: one angle is 30° bigger than the other

find.en: the smaller angle and the bigger angle

do.hi: Bade angle ka extra 30° alag rakho aur use 180° mein se ghatao
do.en: Set aside the bigger angle's extra 30° and take it away from 180°

why.hi: extra hatane par dono angle barabar ho jaate hain, aur bacha hua 150° unka jod hai
why.en: with the extra removed the two angles are equal, and the 150° left is their sum

simpler.hi: Bada angle chhote se 30° zyada hai. Pehle woh extra 30° 180° mein se hatao, taaki bache hisse barabar ho jaayein.
simpler.en: The bigger angle is 30° more than the smaller. First take that extra 30° out of 180°, so the parts left are equal.

do.hi: 150° ko do barabar hisson mein baanto

why.hi: extra hatane ke baad dono angle barabar hain
why.en: after removing the extra, the two angles are equal

simpler.hi: Bache 150° ko do barabar angle mein baantna hai. 150 ko 2 se bhaag do, chhota angle mil jaayega.
simpler.en: The 150° left must be shared into two equal angles. Divide 150 by 2 to get the smaller angle.

prompt.hi: Chhota angle 75° hai, aur bada angle usse 30° zyada hai. Bada angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: The smaller angle is 75°, and the bigger angle is 30° more than it. What is the bigger angle?

simpler.hi: Bada angle chhote se 30° zyada hai. Toh 75° mein 30° jodo.
simpler.en: The bigger angle is 30° more than the smaller. So add 30° to 75°.

why.hi: seedhi patri par chhota angle 75° hai aur bada usse 30° zyada, toh 75° + 30° = 105°
why.en: the smaller angle is 75° and the bigger is 30° more, so 75° + 30° = 105°

why.hi: 75° + 105° = 180°, yaani dono milkar seedhi patri bharte hain, aur 105° − 75° = 30° bhi sahi hai
why.en: 75° + 105° = 180°, so together they fill the straight track, and 105° − 75° = 30° fits as well

prompt.hi: Ek seedhi line par do angle linear pair banate hain. Ek angle 35° hai. Doosra angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: Two angles on a straight line form a linear pair. One angle is 35°. What is the other angle?

why.hi: seedhi line par linear pair milkar 180° hota hai, aur 180° − 35° = 145°
why.en: on a straight line a linear pair makes 180°, and 180° − 35° = 145°

simpler.hi: Linear pair milkar poori seedhi line bharta hai, yaani aadha chakkar. Seedhi line ke angle mein se 35° ghatao.
simpler.en: A linear pair fills a whole straight line, half a turn. Take 35° away from the straight-line angle.

prompt.hi: Ek seedhi sadak se ek gali nikalti hai. Gali aur sadak ke beech ek taraf 70° ka angle hai. Usi seedhi sadak par uske bagal wala angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: A lane leaves a straight road. On one side, the angle between the lane and the road is 70°. What is the angle next to it on the same straight road?

why.hi: sadak seedhi hai toh dono angle milkar 180°, aur 180° − 70° = 110°
why.en: the road is straight so the two angles make 180°, and 180° − 70° = 110°

simpler.hi: Sadak seedhi hai, toh dono bagal wale angle milkar poori seedhi line banate hain. Seedhi line ke angle mein se 70° ghatao.
simpler.en: The road is straight, so the two neighbouring angles together make the whole straight line. Take 70° away from the straight-line angle.

prompt.hi: Ek seedhi line par do angle linear pair banate hain, aur dono angle barabar hain. Har angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: Two angles on a straight line form a linear pair, and both angles are equal. How big is each angle?

why.hi: seedhi line 180° hai aur dono angle barabar hain, toh 180° ÷ 2 = 90°
why.en: a straight line is 180° and both angles are equal, so 180° ÷ 2 = 90°

simpler.hi: Seedhi line ko do barabar hisson mein baantna hai. Toh seedhi line ke angle ka aadha karo.
simpler.en: The straight line has to be shared into two equal parts. So halve the straight-line angle.

say.hi: Protractor ko seedhi line par rakho: ek siraa 0° par, doosra 180° par. Seedhi line aadha chakkar hai, 180°.
say.en: Put a protractor on the straight line: one end at 0°, the other at 180°. A straight line is half a turn, 180°.

simpler.hi: Seedhi line aadha chakkar hai, 180°.
simpler.en: A straight line is half a turn, 180°.

prompt.hi: Seedhi line par linear pair ka ek angle 20° hai. Doosra angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: One angle of a linear pair on a straight line is 20°. What is the other angle?

why.hi: seedhi line par linear pair milkar 180° hota hai, aur 180° − 20° = 160°
why.en: on a straight line a linear pair makes 180°, and 180° − 20° = 160°

simpler.hi: Linear pair ke dono angle milkar seedhi line ka angle banate hain. Usme se 20° ghatao.
simpler.en: The two angles of a linear pair together make the straight-line angle. Take 20° away from it.

remediation.move: turn the ray on the straight line: one angle opens, its neighbour closes, the sum stays 180°; 60° beside 60° would fill only 120°, so the neighbour of 60° is 120°

say.hi: Seedhi line par ray ko ghumao: ek angle khulta hai toh bagal wala band hota hai, jod 180° hi rehta hai. Isliye 60° ke bagal wala angle 120° hai, 60° nahi.
say.en: Turn the ray on the straight line: when one angle opens, the one next to it closes, and the sum stays 180°. So the angle next to 60° is 120°, not 60°.

simpler.hi: Seedhi line par dono angle milkar hamesha 180° rehte hain. Isliye 60° ke bagal wala angle 120° hai, 60° nahi.
simpler.en: On a straight line the two angles always add to 180°. So the angle next to 60° is 120°, not 60°.

prompt.hi: Seedhi line par ek angle 40° hai. Usi line par uske bagal wala angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: An angle on a straight line is 40°. What is the angle next to it on the same line?

why.hi: seedhi line par dono angle milkar 180°, aur 180° − 40° = 140°
why.en: on a straight line the two angles make 180°, and 180° − 40° = 140°

simpler.hi: Bagal wala angle aur 40° milkar poori seedhi line bharte hain. Seedhi line ke angle mein se 40° ghatao.
simpler.en: The neighbouring angle and the 40° together fill the whole straight line. Take 40° away from the straight-line angle.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab ek ray ki jagah do poori seedhi lines ek-doosre ko paar karengi. Wahan chaar angle bante hain, aur har bagal wala joda ek linear pair hota hai.
bridgeToNext.en: Next, instead of one ray, two whole straight lines will cross each other. Four angles form there, and every neighbouring pair is a linear pair.

simpler.hi: Ab do poori seedhi lines ek-doosre ko paar karengi. Board par ek crossing hai, jahan chaar angle bante hain.
simpler.en: Now two whole straight lines will cross each other. On the board there is a crossing where four angles are made.

hook.convey: two straight lines crossing like an X → four angles round the crossing point; the angles directly across the point (through the vertex) are a matching pair; kitchen scissors (blade gap vs handle gap), roads crossing at a chowk

use.hi: Kitchen ki kainchi kholo: dono blades ek X banate hain, aur beech mein screw par crossing hai. Blades ke beech ka gap aur handles ke beech ka gap, screw ke aar-paar aamne-saamne hain.
use.en: Open the kitchen scissors: the two blades make an X, and they cross at the screw in the middle. The gap between the blades and the gap between the handles are across the screw from each other.

use.hi: Chowk par do seedhi sadkein ek-doosre ko paar karti hain aur chaar kone banate hain. Car jis kone se chowk mein aati hai, uske theek saamne chowk ke us paar ek aur kona hai.
use.en: At a chowk two straight roads cross each other and make four corners. Right across the chowk from the corner a car comes in from, there is another corner.

explain.convey: two lines cross at one point → four angles: upar, daayein, neeche, baayein; vertically opposite = across the crossing point (vertex), not one above the other; upar ↔ neeche is one pair → the child finds the other pair for baayein

point.hi: Do seedhi lines X ki tarah crossing banati hain, toh wahan chaar angle bante hain: upar, daayein, neeche aur baayein. Vertically opposite angle woh hain jo crossing bindu ke aar-paar, theek saamne hote hain. Vertically ka matlab vertex yaani crossing bindu se hai, upar-neeche se nahi. Jaise upar aur neeche wale angle ek joda hain.
point.en: When two straight lines cross like an X, four angles form there: top, right, bottom and left. Vertically opposite angles are the ones directly across the crossing point from each other. 'Vertically' refers to the vertex, the crossing point, not to up and down. For example, the top and bottom angles are one pair.

prompt.hi: Toh baayein wale angle ka vertically opposite angle kaunsa hai, upar wala ya daayein wala?
prompt.en: So which angle is vertically opposite the left angle, the top one or the right one?

why.hi: chaar angle mein upar aur neeche ek joda hain, aur baayein wala aar-paar daayein ke theek saamne hai
why.en: of the four angles, top and bottom are one pair, and the left one sits right across from the right one

simpler.hi: X ki crossing par chaar angle bante hain. Jo do angle crossing bindu ke aar-paar theek aamne-saamne hon, woh vertically opposite hain, jaise upar aur neeche wale.
simpler.en: An X crossing makes four angles. The two angles directly across the crossing point from each other are vertically opposite, like the top and bottom ones.

explain.convey: why vertically opposite angles are equal: the right angle 115° makes a linear pair with the top angle (one line) and with the bottom angle (the other line) → both are what 115° needs to reach 180° → top = bottom; the child adds top + bottom = 65° + 65° = 130°

point.hi: Is crossing par daayein wala angle 115° hai. Upar wala angle iske saath ek seedhi line par linear pair banata hai, aur neeche wala angle bhi iske saath doosri seedhi line par linear pair banata hai. Dono ko 180° tak yahi 115° poora karta hai, isliye upar aur neeche wale angle barabar hain.
point.en: At this crossing the right angle is 115°. The top angle makes a linear pair with it on one straight line, and the bottom angle also makes a linear pair with it on the other straight line. The same 115° completes both of them to 180°, so the top and bottom angles are equal.

prompt.hi: Toh is crossing par upar aur neeche wale angle milkar kitne hain?
prompt.en: So at this crossing, what do the top and bottom angles add up to?

why.hi: daayein 115° hai, toh upar aur neeche dono 180° − 115° = 65°, aur 65° + 65° = 130°
why.en: the right one is 115°, so top and bottom are each 180° − 115° = 65°, and 65° + 65° = 130°

simpler.hi: Upar wala aur neeche wala, dono hi 115° ke saath milkar 180° banate hain. Isliye dono angle barabar hote hain.
simpler.en: The top angle and the bottom angle each make 180° together with the 115°. That is why the two are equal.

explain.convey: with letters: lines AB and CD cross at O; angle AOC ↔ angle BOD are vertically opposite because their arms are opposite rays (OA ↔ OB, OC ↔ OD); a neighbour shares an arm → the child names the opposite of angle COB

point.hi: Lines AB aur CD, bindu O par crossing banati hain. Ray OA ki ulti ray OB hai, aur ray OC ki ulti ray OD. Angle AOC ka vertically opposite angle BOD hai, kyunki uski dono bhujayein ulti rays hain. Bagal wala angle ek bhuja share karta hai.
point.en: Lines AB and CD cross at the point O. The opposite ray of ray OA is ray OB, and the opposite ray of ray OC is ray OD. The angle vertically opposite angle AOC is angle BOD, because both its arms are the opposite rays. A neighbouring angle shares an arm.

prompt.hi: Toh angle COB ka vertically opposite angle kaunsa hai, angle AOD ya angle BOD?
prompt.en: So which angle is vertically opposite angle COB, angle AOD or angle BOD?

why.hi: OC ki ulti ray OD hai aur OB ki ulti OA, toh COB ke saamne AOD hai
why.en: the opposite ray of OC is OD and of OB is OA, so AOD is opposite COB

simpler.hi: Vertically opposite angle ki dono bhujayein ulti rays hoti hain. OA ki ulti OB hai aur OC ki ulti OD, isliye AOC ke saamne BOD aata hai.
simpler.en: Both arms of a vertically opposite angle are the opposite rays. OA's opposite is OB and OC's opposite is OD, so BOD is across from AOC.

problem.hi: Do seedhi lakdiyan AB aur CD, bindu O par crossing banati hain. Angle AOC 58° hai. Angle BOD nikaalo, jo crossing ke aar-paar angle AOC ke saamne hai, aur linear pair se dikhao kyun.
problem.en: Two straight sticks AB and CD cross at the point O. Angle AOC is 58°. Find angle BOD, the angle across the crossing from angle AOC, and show why using linear pairs.

simpler.hi: Do seedhi lakdiyan AB aur CD, O par crossing banati hain. Angle AOC 58° hai. Crossing ke aar-paar wala angle BOD chahiye.
simpler.en: Two straight sticks AB and CD cross at O. Angle AOC is 58°. We need angle BOD, the one across the crossing.

givens.en: AB and CD are straight lines crossing at O

why.en: a linear pair adds to 180°

simpler.hi: A, O aur B ek seedhi line par hain. Isliye angle AOC aur angle COB milkar 180° banate hain, toh 180 mein se 58 ghatao.
simpler.en: A, O and B lie on one straight line. So angle AOC and angle COB make 180° together; take 58 away from 180.

do.hi: C, O aur D bhi ek seedhi line par hain, toh angle COB aur angle BOD bhi linear pair hain
do.en: C, O and D are also on one straight line, so angle COB and angle BOD are a linear pair too

why.hi: angle BOD ko bhi 180° tak angle COB hi poora karta hai
why.en: it is angle COB again that completes angle BOD to 180°

simpler.hi: C, O aur D bhi ek seedhi line par hain. Toh angle COB aur angle BOD bhi milkar 180° banate hain.
simpler.en: C, O and D also lie on one straight line. So angle COB and angle BOD also make 180° together.

prompt.hi: Ab 180° − 122° nikaalo. Angle BOD kitna hai?
prompt.en: Now work out 180° − 122°. What is angle BOD?

simpler.hi: 180 mein se 122 ghatao. Dhyan do, yeh angle AOC ke theek aar-paar wala angle hai.
simpler.en: Take 122 away from 180. Notice that this is the angle right across from angle AOC.

why.hi: angle COB 122° hai, aur BOD uske saath linear pair hai, toh 180° − 122° = 58°
why.en: angle COB is 122°, and BOD makes a linear pair with it, so 180° − 122° = 58°

answer.hi: angle BOD 58° hai, bilkul angle AOC ke barabar
answer.en: angle BOD is 58°, exactly equal to angle AOC

why.hi: angle AOC aur angle BOD dono ek hi angle COB ke saath linear pair banate hain, isliye dono 180° − 122° hain
why.en: angle AOC and angle BOD each make a linear pair with the same angle COB, so both are 180° − 122°

prompt.hi: Do seedhi lines X ki tarah crossing banati hain. Baayein wala angle 50° hai. Iska vertically opposite angle kaunsa hai, upar wala ya daayein wala?
prompt.en: Two straight lines cross like an X. The left angle is 50°. Which angle is vertically opposite it, the top one or the right one?

why.hi: baayein wala angle crossing bindu ke aar-paar daayein wale ke theek saamne hai
why.en: the left angle is right across the crossing point from the right angle

simpler.hi: Vertically opposite angle crossing ke aar-paar, theek saamne hota hai. Baayein wale ke theek ulti taraf kaun hai, woh dekho.
simpler.en: A vertically opposite angle is right across the crossing. See which angle is on the exact opposite side from the left one.

prompt.hi: Do seedhi lines crossing banati hain. Upar aur neeche wale angle ka jod 140° hai. Daayein wala angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: Two straight lines cross. The top and bottom angles add up to 140°. What is the right angle?

why.hi: upar aur neeche ka jod 140° hai, toh har ek 70°, aur daayein wala angle 180° − 70° = 110°
why.en: top and bottom add to 140°, so each is 70°, and the right angle is 180° − 70° = 110°

simpler.hi: Upar aur neeche wale angle barabar hote hain, toh 140° ka aadha ek angle hai. Daayein wala uske saath milkar seedhi line poori karta hai.
simpler.en: The top and bottom angles are equal, so one of them is half of 140°. The right angle completes a straight line with it.

prompt.hi: Lines PQ aur RS, bindu O par crossing banati hain. Angle POR ka vertically opposite angle kaunsa hai, angle QOS ya angle ROQ?
prompt.en: Lines PQ and RS cross at the point O. Which angle is vertically opposite angle POR, angle QOS or angle ROQ?

why.hi: line PQ mein ray OP ki ulti ray OQ, aur line RS mein OR ki ulti OS, toh POR ke saamne QOS
why.en: on line PQ ray OQ is opposite OP, and on line RS OS is opposite OR, so QOS faces POR

simpler.hi: Saamne wala angle woh hai jiski dono bhujayein ulti rays hon. OP ki ulti OQ hai aur OR ki ulti OS.
simpler.en: The opposite angle is the one whose two arms are the opposite rays. OP's opposite is OQ and OR's opposite is OS.

remediation.move: turn the whole X sideways: the matching pair stays across the vertex, whatever is up or down; 'vertically' comes from vertex; the angle just above the left one shares an arm with it, so it is a neighbour

say.hi: Vertically ka matlab upar-neeche nahi, vertex yaani crossing bindu hai. X ko kitna bhi ghumao, saamne wale angle hamesha bindu ke aar-paar rehte hain, bagal mein nahi.
say.en: 'Vertically' does not mean up and down; it refers to the vertex, the crossing point. However much you turn the X, opposite angles always stay across the point, never side by side.

simpler.hi: Vertically ka matlab vertex hai, yaani crossing bindu. Saamne wale angle hamesha bindu ke aar-paar hote hain, bagal mein nahi.
simpler.en: 'Vertically' refers to the vertex, the crossing point. Opposite angles are always across that point, never side by side.

prompt.hi: Crossing par daayein wala angle 40° hai. Iska vertically opposite kaunsa hai, neeche wala ya baayein wala?
prompt.en: At a crossing the right angle is 40°. Which angle is vertically opposite it, the bottom one or the left one?

why.hi: daayein wale ke theek saamne, crossing bindu ke aar-paar, baayein wala hai
why.en: right across the crossing point from the right angle is the left one

simpler.hi: Neeche wala angle daayein ke bagal mein hai, saamne nahi. Daayein wale ke theek ulti taraf dekho.
simpler.en: The bottom angle is next to the right one, not across from it. Look at the exact opposite side from the right angle.

remediation.move: rotate one stick slowly: the top and bottom angles grow together while the left and right ones shrink together → only the opposite pairs stay equal, neighbours do not

say.hi: Ek line ko dheere-dheere ghumao: upar aur neeche wale angle saath mein badhte hain, aur daayein aur baayein wale saath mein ghatte hain. Isliye sirf saamne wale angle barabar hote hain, bagal wale nahi.
say.en: Turn one line slowly: the top and bottom angles grow together, and the right and left ones shrink together. So only opposite angles are equal, not neighbouring ones.

simpler.hi: Line ghumao toh saamne wale angle saath mein badhte ya ghatte hain. Isliye sirf saamne wale angle barabar hote hain, bagal wale nahi.
simpler.en: Turn a line and opposite angles grow or shrink together. So only opposite angles are equal, not neighbouring ones.

prompt.hi: Crossing par upar aur neeche wale angle ka jod 140° hai. Baayein wala angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: At a crossing the top and bottom angles add up to 140°. What is the left angle?

why.hi: upar aur neeche ka jod 140° hai, toh har ek 70°, aur baayein wala angle 180° − 70° = 110°
why.en: top and bottom add to 140°, so each is 70°, and the left angle is 180° − 70° = 110°

simpler.hi: Upar aur neeche wale barabar hain, toh 140° ka aadha ek angle hai. Baayein wala uske saath milkar seedhi line poori karta hai.
simpler.en: The top and bottom angles are equal, so one of them is half of 140°. The left angle completes a straight line with it.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab do niyam tumhare paas hain: bagal wale angle milkar 180°, aur saamne wale angle barabar. Agle hisse mein sirf ek angle se crossing ke chaaron angle nikaalenge.
bridgeToNext.en: Now you have two rules: neighbouring angles add to 180°, and opposite angles are equal. In the next part we will find all four angles at a crossing from just one angle.

simpler.hi: Ab ek angle se crossing ke baaki angle nikaalenge. Board par crossing ka ek angle 50° dikh raha hai.
simpler.en: Now we find the other angles at a crossing from one angle. On the board one angle of the crossing shows 50°.

hook.convey: one measured angle at a crossing is enough: across it → the same; next to it → 180° minus it; going round: x, 180° − x, x, 180° − x; crossed cricket bats, two roads at a chowk

use.hi: Do cricket bat X ki tarah ek-doosre par rakhe hain. Beech mein chaar angle bante hain, aur sirf ek angle naap lo toh baaki teen bhi bina naape pata chal jaate hain.
use.en: Two cricket bats lie across each other like an X. Four angles form in the middle, and if you measure just one, you can know the other three without measuring.

use.hi: Chowk par do seedhi sadkein milti hain. Bus driver ko sirf ek kone ka angle pata hai, phir bhi chowk ke chaaron kone ke angle nikal sakte hain.
use.en: Two straight roads meet at a chowk. The bus driver knows the angle of only one corner, and still we can find the angles of all four corners.

explain.convey: one angle 50° on top → the bottom one is across it → also 50°; the right and left ones each make a linear pair with the top → each 180° − 50°; the child finds the right angle 130°

point.hi: Is crossing par upar wala angle 50° hai. Neeche wala iske saamne, crossing ke aar-paar hai, toh woh bhi 50° hai. Daayein aur baayein wale angle, dono upar wale ke saath ek-ek linear pair banate hain.
point.en: At this crossing the top angle is 50°. The bottom one is opposite it, across the crossing, so it is 50° as well. The right and left angles each make a linear pair with the top one.

prompt.hi: Toh is crossing par daayein wala angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: So what is the right angle at this crossing?

why.hi: daayein wala upar ke 50° ke saath linear pair hai, aur 180° − 50° = 130°
why.en: the right angle makes a linear pair with the top 50°, and 180° − 50° = 130°

simpler.hi: Saamne wala angle barabar hota hai, toh neeche wala bhi 50° hai. Bagal wala angle 50° ke saath milkar poori seedhi line banata hai.
simpler.en: The opposite angle is equal, so the bottom one is also 50°. A neighbouring angle makes a whole straight line together with the 50°.

explain.convey: going round the crossing: top, right, bottom, left = x, 180° − x, x, 180° − x; all four together = a full turn round the point = 360°, a check on the answer; board 40° and 140° → the child adds the four

mustSay.en: the bottom one equals the top one

point.hi: Is crossing par upar wala angle 40° aur daayein wala 140° hai. Neeche wala upar ke barabar hai aur baayein wala daayein ke barabar.
point.en: At this crossing the top angle is 40° and the right one is 140°. The bottom one equals the top one, and the left one equals the right one.

prompt.hi: Toh is crossing ke chaaron angle ka jod kitna hai?
prompt.en: So what is the sum of all four angles at this crossing?

why.hi: upar 40°, daayein 140°, neeche 40° aur baayein 140° hain: 40° + 140° + 40° + 140° = 360°

simpler.hi: Saamne wale angle barabar hote hain. Toh chaaron angle hain 40°, 140°, 40° aur 140°.
simpler.en: Opposite angles are equal. So the four angles are 40°, 140°, 40° and 140°.

problem.hi: Do seedhi lines crossing banati hain. Ek angle 72° hai. Baaki teeno angle nikaalo.
problem.en: Two straight lines cross. One angle is 72°. Find the other three angles.

simpler.hi: Aamne-saamne wale angle barabar hote hain. Bagal wale do angle milkar 180° bante hain.
simpler.en: Angles opposite each other are equal. Two angles side by side make 180° together.

givens.hi: do seedhi lines crossing banati hain, toh chaar angle hain
givens.en: two straight lines cross, so there are four angles

find.en: how big the other three angles are

do.hi: 72° ke saamne, crossing ke aar-paar wala angle lo
do.en: Take the angle across the crossing from the 72°

why.hi: vertically opposite angle barabar hote hain
why.en: vertically opposite angles are equal

simpler.hi: Crossing ke aar-paar wala angle hamesha barabar hota hai. Toh 72° ke saamne wala angle bhi utna hi hai.
simpler.en: The angle across the crossing is always equal. So the angle opposite the 72° is the same size.

do.hi: 72° ke ek taraf bagal wala angle nikaalo
do.en: Find the angle next to the 72° on one side

why.hi: bagal wale angle ek seedhi line par linear pair banate hain
why.en: neighbouring angles form a linear pair on a straight line

simpler.hi: Bagal wala angle 72° ke saath milkar seedhi line banata hai. Isliye 180° mein se 72° ghatao.
simpler.en: The neighbouring angle makes a straight line together with the 72°. So take 72° away from 180°.

prompt.hi: Ab chautha angle bacha hai, jo 72° ke doosri taraf bagal mein hai. Woh kitna hai?
prompt.en: Now the fourth angle is left, next to the 72° on its other side. How big is it?

simpler.hi: Chautha angle bhi 72° ke bagal mein hai. Toh woh bhi 72° ke saath seedhi line banata hai, pichhle bagal wale angle jaisa.
simpler.en: The fourth angle is also next to the 72°. So it too makes a straight line with the 72°, just like the other neighbour.

why.hi: chautha angle 72° ke saath linear pair hai, toh 180° − 72° = 108°
why.en: the fourth angle makes a linear pair with 72°, so 180° − 72° = 108°

answer.en: the other three angles are 72°, 108° and 108°

why.hi: saamne wale angle barabar, bagal wale milkar 180°, aur 72° + 108° + 72° + 108° = 360° bhi milta hai
why.en: opposite angles are equal and neighbouring ones make 180°, and 72° + 108° + 72° + 108° = 360° checks out too

prompt.hi: Do seedhi lines crossing banati hain. Ek angle 35° hai. Baaki teeno angle ghoomte hue batao, uske bagal wale se shuru karke.
prompt.en: Two straight lines cross. One angle is 35°. Give the other three angles going round, starting with the one next to it.

why.hi: bagal wale 180° − 35° = 145° hain, aur saamne wala bhi 35° hai
why.en: the neighbours are 180° − 35° = 145°, and the opposite one is 35° too

simpler.hi: Bagal wala angle 35° ke saath milkar seedhi line poori karta hai. Saamne wala angle 35° ke barabar hota hai.
simpler.en: A neighbouring angle completes a straight line with the 35°. The opposite angle is equal to the 35°.

prompt.hi: Patang ki do seedhi dor ek-doosre ko paar karti hain. Upar wala angle 64° hai. Baayein wala angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: Two straight kite strings cross each other. The top angle is 64°. What is the left angle?

why.hi: baayein wala upar ke saath linear pair hai, aur 180° − 64° = 116°
why.en: the left angle makes a linear pair with the top, and 180° − 64° = 116°

simpler.hi: Baayein wala angle upar wale ke bagal mein hai. Dono milkar seedhi line ka angle banate hain, toh usme se 64° ghatao.
simpler.en: The left angle is next to the top one. Together they make the straight-line angle, so take 64° away from it.

prompt.hi: Do seedhi lines crossing banati hain. Baayein wala angle 100° hai. Upar wala angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: Two straight lines cross. The left angle is 100°. What is the top angle?

why.hi: upar wala baayein ke saath linear pair hai, aur 180° − 100° = 80°
why.en: the top angle makes a linear pair with the left, and 180° − 100° = 80°

simpler.hi: Upar wala angle baayein wale ke bagal mein hai. Seedhi line ke angle mein se 100° ghatao.
simpler.en: The top angle is next to the left one. Take 100° away from the straight-line angle.

ladder.why: first straight use: one angle 40° → all four, 40°, 140°, 40°, 140°
error-spot: Pooja writes 70° for all four → only the opposite one is 70°, the neighbours 110°
all four in a set order (top, right, bottom, left) from a top angle of 127°
far transfer: ironing-board legs crossing at 52° → the other three angles
one corner 3 times its neighbour at a chowk → linear pair split 1 : 3, then all four

remediation.move: fix a wrongly marked crossing: only the angle across matches the given one; the two neighbours share a straight line with it, so each is 180° minus it; 60° → 60°, 120°, 60°, 120°

say.hi: Ek angle 60° ho toh sirf uske saamne wala angle 60° hota hai. Bagal wale dono angle uske saath seedhi line bharte hain, isliye woh 120° hain.
say.en: If one angle is 60°, only the angle opposite it is 60°. The two neighbouring angles fill a straight line with it, so they are 120°.

simpler.hi: 60° ke saamne wala angle bhi 60° hai. Bagal wale dono uske saath seedhi line banate hain, isliye woh 120° hain.
simpler.en: The angle opposite 60° is also 60°. The two neighbours make a straight line with it, so they are 120°.

prompt.hi: Crossing par ek angle 25° hai. Baaki teeno angle ghoomte hue batao, uske bagal wale se shuru karke.
prompt.en: One angle at a crossing is 25°. Give the other three angles going round, starting with the one next to it.

why.hi: bagal wale 180° − 25° = 155° hain, aur saamne wala bhi 25° hai
why.en: the neighbours are 180° − 25° = 155°, and the opposite one is 25° too

simpler.hi: Bagal wala angle 25° ke saath milkar seedhi line poori karta hai. Saamne wala angle 25° ke barabar hota hai.
simpler.en: A neighbouring angle completes a straight line with the 25°. The opposite angle is equal to the 25°.

remediation.move: protractor fan: the two neighbouring angles together open from one arm to the straight line, a half turn of 180°; 90° stops at the corner, only half of it

say.hi: Bagal wale do angle milkar ek seedhi line banate hain, aur seedhi line 180° hai, 90° nahi. 90° toh sirf ek kona hai, seedhi line ka aadha.
say.en: Two neighbouring angles together make a straight line, and a straight line is 180°, not 90°. 90° is only a corner, half of a straight line.

simpler.hi: Bagal wale do angle milkar seedhi line banate hain, yaani 180°, 90° nahi.
simpler.en: Two neighbouring angles together make a straight line, which is 180°, not 90°.

prompt.hi: Crossing par upar wala angle 30° hai. Daayein wala angle kitna hai?
prompt.en: At a crossing the top angle is 30°. What is the right angle?

why.hi: daayein wala upar ke saath linear pair hai, aur 180° − 30° = 150°
why.en: the right angle makes a linear pair with the top, and 180° − 30° = 150°

simpler.hi: Daayein wala angle upar wale ke bagal mein hai. Seedhi line ke angle mein se 30° ghatao.
simpler.en: The right angle is next to the top one. Take 30° away from the straight-line angle.

remediation.move: trace across the vertex with a finger: from the left angle through the crossing point you land on the right angle; the angle just above the left one shares an arm with it → a neighbour, so it makes 180° with it

say.hi: Saamne wala angle crossing bindu ke aar-paar hota hai: baayein ke saamne daayein, aur upar ke saamne neeche. Baayein wale ke upar jo angle hai, woh uska bagal wala hai.
say.en: The opposite angle is across the crossing point: right is opposite left, and bottom is opposite top. The angle above the left one is its neighbour.

simpler.hi: Saamne wala angle bindu ke aar-paar hota hai: baayein ke saamne daayein, upar ke saamne neeche.
simpler.en: The opposite angle is across the point: right is opposite left, bottom is opposite top.

prompt.en: At a crossing the right angle is 75°. What is the bottom angle?

why.hi: neeche wala daayein ke saath linear pair hai, aur 180° − 75° = 105°
why.en: the bottom angle makes a linear pair with the right, and 180° − 75° = 105°

simpler.hi: Neeche wala angle daayein wale ke bagal mein hai. Seedhi line ke angle mein se 75° ghatao.
simpler.en: The bottom angle is next to the right one. Take 75° away from the straight-line angle.
